import openpyxl, os
out = os.environ['OUT_XLSX']
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(out)
ws = wb.active
last = {}
for r in range(4, 17):
    sn = ws.cell(row=r, column=2).value
    w = ws.cell(row=r, column=4).value
    if sn in last:
        used = last[sn] - w
    else:
        used = 0
    ws.cell(row=r, column=5).value = used
    last[sn] = w
wb.save(out)
print('done')
